definitions.short: Eder , the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H5740. Eder II. עֵ֫דֶר proper name, masculine (compare Nabataean proper name עדרו = Arabic Lzb 337 ); — a Levite 1Chr 23:23 ; 24:30 , ᵐ5 Αιδαθ , Ηλα , A ᵐ5 L Εδερ . III. עֵ֫דֶר proper name, of a location in extreme south of Judah Josh 15:21 , site unknown; ᵐ5 Αρα , A Εδραι , ᵐ5 L Εβερ .
